<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Domain\User\UserAggregateRoot;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

/**
 * Restore previously expired points (gettoni) to users (maintenance / correction).
 * Re-credits the amount and annotates the expired_points history as restored.
 */
class RestoreExpiredPoints extends Command
{
    /**
     * @var string
     */
    protected $signature = 'app:restore-expired-points
        {user? : ID di un singolo utente (per test spot); se omesso vengono processati tutti}
        {--date= : Ripristina solo le scadenze di questa data (Y-m-d); se omesso, tutte le scadenze non ancora ripristinate}
        {--reason=Ripristino punti scaduti : Motivo del ripristino}
        {--dry-run : Mostra cosa verrebbe ripristinato senza registrare eventi}';

    /**
     * @var string
     */
    protected $description = 'Ripristina i punti scaduti agli utenti (correzione/manutenzione)';

    public function handle(): int
    {
        $restoredAt = now('Europe/Rome')->toDateTimeString();
        $dryRun = (bool) $this->option('dry-run');
        $userId = $this->argument('user');
        $date = $this->option('date');
        $reason = (string) $this->option('reason');

        $usersAffected = 0;
        $pointsRestored = 0;

        User::query()
            ->when($userId, fn ($q) => $q->whereKey($userId))
            ->whereHas('stats', fn ($q) => $q->whereNotNull('expired_points'))
            ->with('stats')
            ->chunkById(200, function ($users) use (&$usersAffected, &$pointsRestored, $dryRun, $date, $reason, $restoredAt) {
                foreach ($users as $user) {
                    // select the non-restored entries, optionally filtered by date
                    $entries = $this->entriesToRestore($user->stats->expired_points ?? [], $date);

                    if (empty($entries)) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    $amount = (int) array_sum(array_column($entries, 'amount'));

                    $usersAffected++;
                    $pointsRestored += $amount;

                    if ($dryRun) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    // record the restore through the aggregate: the UserProjector
                    // is the only place that mutates the UserStat balance.
                    UserAggregateRoot::retrieve($user->uuid)
                        ->restoreExpiredPoints($entries, $reason, $restoredAt)
                        ->persist();
                }
            });

        $message = ($dryRun ? '[DRY-RUN] ' : '')
            .'Ripristino punti scaduti'.($date ? " del {$date}" : '').": {$usersAffected} utenti, {$pointsRestored} punti ripristinati.";

        $this->info($message);

        Log::info('Expired points restore', [
            'restored_at' => $restoredAt,
            'dry_run' => $dryRun,
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'date' => $date,
            'reason' => $reason,
            'users' => $usersAffected,
            'points' => $pointsRestored,
        ]);

        return Command::SUCCESS;
    }


    /**
     * Pick the expiry entries eligible for restore: those not yet restored,
     * optionally filtered by a specific expiry date.
     * @param array<int,array<string,mixed>> $history
     * @param string|null $date
     * @return array<int,array{date:string,amount:int}>
     */
    private function entriesToRestore(array $history, ?string $date): array
    {
        $entries = [];

        foreach ($history as $entry) {
            // skip entries already restored
            if (!empty($entry['restored_at'])) {
                continue;
            }

            // optional filter by expiry date
            if ($date && $entry['date'] !== $date) {
                continue;
            }

            $entries[] = [
                'date' => $entry['date'],
                'amount' => (int) $entry['amount'],
            ];
        }

        return $entries;
    }
}

Serve per ripristinare (riaccreditare) i punti/gettoni scaduti agli utenti, come correzione manutentiva dopo lo scadenziamento fatto da `ExpirePoints`.

**Uso:**
```
php artisan app:restore-expired-points [user] [--date=Y-m-d] [--reason="..."] [--dry-run]
```

- `user` (opzionale): ID di un singolo utente, altrimenti processa tutti quelli con scadenze non ripristinate
- `--date=`: limita il ripristino alle scadenze di una data specifica
- `--reason=`: motivo registrato nello storico (default: "Ripristino punti scaduti")
- `--dry-run`: simula senza registrare eventi

Internamente marca come non-restored le entries in `expired_points`, e per ognuna passa da `UserAggregateRoot::restoreExpiredPoints()` (event sourcing, gestito poi da `UserProjector`) — non tocca direttamente il saldo.

<?php

namespace App\Domain\AwardRedeem;

use App\Domain\AwardRedeem\Events\AwardRedeemApproved;
use App\Domain\AwardRedeem\Events\AwardRedeemCreated;
use App\Domain\AwardRedeem\Events\AwardRedeemRejected;
use App\Domain\AwardRedeem\Events\PointsDeducted;
use App\Domain\AwardRedeem\Events\PointsRestored;
use App\Domain\AwardRedeem\Exceptions\AwardRedeemCannotBeModified;
use App\Domain\AwardRedeem\Exceptions\UserCannotRequestAwardWithoutEnoughPoints;
use App\Enums\AwardRedeemStatus;
use App\Models\Award;
use App\Models\User;
use Spatie\EventSourcing\AggregateRoots\AggregateRoot;

/**
 * This aggregate is used to manage the request for an award
 */
class AwardRedeemAggregateRoot extends AggregateRoot
{
    /**
     * User that requested the award
     */
    public string $userUuid;

    /**
     * Current status of the request
     */
    protected AwardRedeemStatus $status = AwardRedeemStatus::PENDING;

    /**
     * Award that is requested
     */
    public ?Award $award = null;

    /**
     * Reason provided at the time of rejecting
     */
    protected ?string $rejectReason = null;

    /**
     * Flag to check if the request is locked
     * (i.e., it cannot be modified anymore because it has been approved or rejected)
     */
    protected bool $locked = false;


    /**
     * Points related to the award redeem request.
     */
    public int $awardRedeemPoints = 0;

    /**
     * Whether a request has already been created on this aggregate.
     * Used to make the submit idempotent and absorb double-submits: a fresh
     * aggregate has no award applied yet, a replayed one (same uuid) does.
     */
    public function isAlreadyCreated(): bool
    {
        return $this->award !== null;
    }


    /**
     * Create request for an award.
     * Users since 2025/08/25 can request the same award multiple times.
     * @param array<string,mixed> $requestPayload data that was provided by the user at the time of request
     */
    public function createRequest(
        Award $award,
        User $user,
        array $requestPayload
    ): static {

        // check if user has enough points to redeem the award
        if ($user->stats->available_points < $award->redeem_points) {
            throw new UserCannotRequestAwardWithoutEnoughPoints(
                $user->id,
                $award->id
            );
        }

        $createdEvent = new AwardRedeemCreated(
            $award->id,
            $user->uuid,
            $award->redeem_points,
            $requestPayload,
        );
        $this->recordThat($createdEvent);

        $this->recordThat(
            (new PointsDeducted(
                $user->uuid,
                $award->redeem_points
            ))
            ->sourceEvent($createdEvent)
        );


        return $this;
    }


    /**
     *
     */
    public function applyAwardRedeemCreated(AwardRedeemCreated $event): void
    {
        $this->userUuid = $event->userUuid;

        $this->award = Award::find($event->awardId);

        $this->status = AwardRedeemStatus::PENDING;

        $this->locked = false;

        $this->awardRedeemPoints = $event->price;

        // If the award is not found, throw an exception
        if (!$this->award) {
            throw new \Exception("Award with ID {$event->awardId} not found.");
        }
    }


    /**
     * Reject a request
     */
    public function reject(?string $reason, ?int $authUserId = null): static
    {
        $this->checkLock();

        $rejectedEvent = new AwardRedeemRejected($reason, $authUserId);

        $this->recordThat($rejectedEvent);

        $this->recordThat(
            new PointsRestored(
                $this->userUuid,
                $this->awardRedeemPoints
            )
        );

        return $this;

    }


    public function applyAwardRedeemRejected(AwardRedeemRejected $event): void
    {
        $this->status = AwardRedeemStatus::REJECTED;

        $this->rejectReason = $event->reason;

        $this->locked = true;
    }


    /**
     * Approve a request
     * @param int|null $authUserId ID of the user that is approving the request
     */
    public function approve(?int $authUserId = null): static
    {
        $this->checkLock();

        $this->recordThat(new AwardRedeemApproved($authUserId));



        return $this;

    }

    public function applyAwardRedeemApproved(AwardRedeemApproved $event): void
    {
        $this->status = AwardRedeemStatus::APPROVED;

        $this->locked = true;

    }

    /**
     * Check if the request is locked before change status
     * @throws \Exception
     */
    protected function checkLock(): void
    {
        if ($this->locked) {
            throw new AwardRedeemCannotBeModified($this->uuid());
        }

Confermato: sì, annullando una richiesta premio (impostando lo stato su "Cancellato" = `REJECTED`), i punti **vengono ripristinati automaticamente**.

Il flusso è:
1. `AwardRedeemAggregateRoot::reject()` ([AwardRedeemAggregateRoot.php:130-147](app/Domain/AwardRedeem/AwardRedeemAggregateRoot.php#L130-L147)) registra sia l'evento `AwardRedeemRejected` sia `PointsRestored` con l'importo dei punti della richiesta (`awardRedeemPoints`).
2. `UserProjector::onPointsRestored()` ([UserProjector.php:235-247](app/Domain/User/Projectors/UserProjector.php#L235-L247)) incrementa `available_points` dell'utente.

Quindi per quel caso specifico è già gestito, senza bisogno di note aggiuntive (non c'è un campo motivazione salvato per questo evento, solo l'eventuale `rejectReason` della richiesta).

Ora guardo come è strutturato il resto (UserAggregateRoot, UserStat) per capire il modo più coerente di aggiungere un comando/azione di **riaccredito generico con nota**.

    {

            return $this;
        }

        $this->recordThat(new Events\PointsExpired($currentAvailablePoints, $expiredAt));

        return $this;
    }

     */
    public function restoreExpiredPoints(array $entries, string $reason, string $restoredAt): static
    {
        $amount = (int) array_sum(array_column($entries, 'amount'));

        // nothing to restore

            return $this;
        }

        $this->recordThat(new Events\ExpiredPointsRestored($amount, $entries, $reason, $restoredAt));

php artisan development:add-points {userId} {pointsAmount} "Correzione: richiesta premio #{awardRedeemId} erroneamente segnata come evasa"
```

        AwardRedeemCreated::class => 'onAwardRedeemCreated',
    ];

    /**
     * User attributes that are used to create the award redeem
     * and user must fill them in the request form.
     * @var array<int,string>
     */
    protected array $userAttributes = [
        'firstname',
        'lastname',
        'postcode',
        'city',
        'address',
        'address_number',
        'province',
        'phone',
    ];

    /**
     * An award has been requested.
     * Create a relation record with the user and the award
     */
    public function onAwardRedeemCreated(AwardRedeemCreated $event): void
    {

        // retrieve the user
        $user = User::findUuid($event->userUuid);

        // retrieve the award
        $award = Award::find($event->awardId);

        // build user data from payload
        $userData = [];
        foreach ($this->userAttributes as $attribute) {
            $userData['user_'.$attribute] = $event->requestPayload[$attribute];
        }

        // add additional user data from user model
        $userData['user_email'] = $user->email;
        $userData['user_country'] = $user->country;


        // create an award redeem
        AwardRedeem::create(array_merge([
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'uuid' => $event->aggregateRootUuid(),
            'award_id' => $award->id,
            'award_name' => $award->name,
            'award_redeem_points' => $award->redeem_points,
            'requested_at' => now(),
        ], $userData));
    }


    /**
     * A request has been rejected
     */
    public function onAwardRedeemRejected(AwardRedeemRejected $event): void
    {

        // retrieve the award redeem
        $awardRedeem = AwardRedeem::findUuid($event->aggregateRootUuid());

        $this->checkLock($awardRedeem);

        // update the award redeem
        $awardRedeem->update([
            'status' => \App\Enums\AwardRedeemStatus::REJECTED,
            'reject_reason' => $event->reason,
            'rejected_at' => now(),
        ]);
    }


    /**
     * A request has been approved
     */
    public function onAwardRedeemApproved(AwardRedeemApproved $event): void
    {

        // retrieve the award redeem
        $awardRedeem = AwardRedeem::findUuid($event->aggregateRootUuid());

        $this->checkLock($awardRedeem);

        // update the award redeem
        $awardRedeem->update([
            'status' => \App\Enums\AwardRedeemStatus::APPROVED,
            'approved_at' => now(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Check if request is pending before approving
     * @throws AwardRedeemCannotBeModified
     */
    public function checkLock(AwardRedeem $awardRedeem): void
    {
        // check if request is pending
        if ($awardRedeem->status !== \App\Enums\AwardRedeemStatus::PENDING) {
            throw new AwardRedeemCannotBeModified($awardRedeem->uuid);
        }
    }

}

Il rischio principale nel togliere semplicemente il lock è la **doppia erogazione dei punti**: `reject()` fa scattare `PointsRestored` in modo incondizionato, senza controllare se la richiesta è già stata rifiutata in precedenza. Senza lock, un doppio click, una bulk action, o un secondo "annulla" per errore su una richiesta già cancellata riaccrediterebbe i punti una seconda volta — bug silenzioso e difficile da individuare dato che è event-sourced (nessun vincolo DB te lo impedisce).

C'è poi una perdita di significato del dato: il lock oggi garantisce che approvato/rifiutato siano stati **terminali** — altro codice nella UI si appoggia a questo (es. la bulk action controlla `allPending` prima di permettere il cambio stato). Togliendolo globalmente indebolisci quella garanzia per *tutto* il flusso normale, non solo per il caso "correzione admin" che ti serve — e gli eventi `AwardRedeemApproved`/`AwardRedeemRejected` non hanno un campo nota, quindi anche togliendo il lock dovresti comunque modificarli per registrare la motivazione che vuoi.

Un percorso di correzione dedicato, invece, resta un'eccezione esplicita e circoscritta (solo da APPROVED, con nota obbligatoria, senza toccare la garanzia di immutabilità del flusso ordinario) — più codice, ma comportamento più sicuro e più facile da controllare/loggare.

class AwardRedeemTest extends TestCase
{
    use DatabaseTransactions;

    /**
     * @return array<mixed>
     */
    public static function factory(): array
    {
        $user = \App\Models\User::factory()->has(
            UserStat::factory()->state([
                'available_points' => rand(1, 1000),
                'redemeed_points' => 0,
                'requested_awards_count' => 0,
                'approved_awards_count' => 0,
                'rejected_awards_count' => 0,
            ]),
            'stats'
        )->create([
            'firstname' => null,
            'lastname' => null,
        ]);

        $award = \App\Models\Award::factory()->create([
            'redeem_points' => rand(1, $user->stats->available_points),
        ]);

        $formData = [
            'firstname' => fake()->firstName(),
            'lastname' => fake()->lastName(),
            'address' => fake()->address(),
            'address_number' => fake()->buildingNumber(),
            'postcode' => fake()->postcode(),
            'province' => fake()->state(),
            'city' => fake()->city(),
            'phone' => fake()->phoneNumber(),
        ];

        return [
            $user,
            $award,
            $formData,
        ];
    }

    public function test_user_can_request_award(): void
    {
        [$user, $award, $formData] = $this->factory();
        $pointsBeforeRequest = $user->stats->available_points;

        Notification::fake();

        // create an award redeem
        $newUuid = Str::uuid();
        AwardRedeemAggregateRoot::retrieve($newUuid)
            ->createRequest(
                $award,
                $user,
                $formData,
            )->persist();

        // retrieve the model that should have been created
        $awardRedeem = \App\Models\AwardRedeem::where('uuid', $newUuid)->first();
        $this->assertNotNull($awardRedeem);

        $user->refresh();

        // check data related to the user
        foreach ([
            'email'
        ] as $field) {
            $this->assertNotNull($awardRedeem->{'user_'.$field}, 'User '.$field.' should not be null');
            $this->assertEquals($awardRedeem->{'user_'.$field}, $user->{$field});
        }

        // check data coming from form
        foreach ($formData as $field => $value) {
            $this->assertEquals($awardRedeem->{'user_'.$field}, $value);
        }


        $this->assertEquals($user->id, $awardRedeem->user_id);
        $this->assertEquals($award->id, $awardRedeem->award_id);
        $this->assertEquals($award->name, $awardRedeem->award_name);
        $this->assertEquals($award->redeem_points, $awardRedeem->award_redeem_points);
        $this->assertEquals(\App\Enums\AwardRedeemStatus::PENDING, $awardRedeem->status);
        $this->assertTrue($awardRedeem->requested_at->isToday());
        $this->assertTrue($awardRedeem->award->is($award));
        $this->assertTrue($awardRedeem->user->is($user));

        // check stored event
        $event = EloquentStoredEvent::query()
            ->where('event_class', \App\Domain\AwardRedeem\Events\AwardRedeemCreated::class)
            ->where('aggregate_uuid', $newUuid)
            ->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertEquals($user->uuid, $event->event_properties['userUuid']);

        $this->assertEquals($award->redeem_points, $event->event_properties['price']);
        $this->assertEquals($awardRedeem->uuid, $event->aggregate_uuid);

        // check points deducted event
        $event = EloquentStoredEvent::query()
            ->where('event_class', \App\Domain\AwardRedeem\Events\PointsDeducted::class)
            ->where('aggregate_uuid', $newUuid)
            ->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertEquals($user->uuid, $event->event_properties['userUuid']);
        $this->assertEquals($award->redeem_points, $event->event_properties['pointsAmount']);
        $this->assertEquals($awardRedeem->uuid, $event->aggregate_uuid);

        // check that points have been deducted from the user
        $pointsThatShouldBeAvailable = $pointsBeforeRequest - $award->redeem_points;
        $this->assertEquals(
            $pointsThatShouldBeAvailable,
            $user->stats->fresh()->available_points
        );

        // check that redeemed points have been updated
        $this->assertEquals(
            $award->redeem_points,
            $user->stats->fresh()->redemeed_points
        );

        // check that the user has requested an award
        $this->assertEquals(
            1,
            $user->stats->fresh()->requested_awards_count
        );


        Notification::assertSentTo(

            \App\Notifications\AwardRedeemCreated::class,
            function (\App\Notifications\AwardRedeemCreated $notification) use ($awardRedeem) {
                return $notification->awardRedeem->is($awardRedeem);
            }
        );

    public function test_award_redeem_request_is_rejected(): void
    {

        Notification::fake();

        [$user, $award, $formData] = $this->factory();


        // create an award redeem
        $newUuid = Str::uuid();
        $aggregateRoot = AwardRedeemAggregateRoot::retrieve($newUuid)
            ->createRequest(
                $award,
                $user,
                $formData,
            )->persist();

        // check that points have been deducted from the user
        $pointsAfterRequest = $user->stats->available_points - $award->redeem_points;
        $this->assertEquals(

            $user->stats->fresh()->available_points
        );

        // reject the request and persist
        $aggregateRoot->reject(

        );
        $aggregateRoot->persist();

## Riepilogo

Implementato il flusso di correzione stato per richieste premio erroneamente evase:

**Domain** ([AwardRedeemAggregateRoot.php](app/Domain/AwardRedeem/AwardRedeemAggregateRoot.php)): nuovo metodo `correctStatus(AwardRedeemStatus $newStatus, string $note, ?int $authUserId)` — bypassa intenzionalmente il lock, ma solo da stato `APPROVED` verso `PENDING` o `REJECTED`; richiede una nota obbligatoria; se il target è `REJECTED` fa scattare automaticamente `PointsRestored` (stesso importo del reject normale), se `PENDING` non tocca i punti (restano scalati dalla creazione, come confermato in precedenza).

**Nuovo evento** `AwardRedeemStatusCorrected` (event-sourced) + eccezione dedicata `AwardRedeemCorrectionNotAllowed`.

**Projector** ([AwardRedeemProjector.php](app/Domain/AwardRedeem/Projectors/AwardRedeemProjector.php)): aggiorna stato, azzera `approved_at`, imposta `rejected_at`/`reject_reason` se cancellata, e salva `correction_note`, `status_corrected_at`, `status_corrected_by` (nuove colonne via migration).

**UserProjector**: mantiene coerenti i contatori `approved_awards_count`/`rejected_awards_count`.

**UI Filament** ([EditAwardRedeem.php](app/Filament/Resources/AwardRedeemResource/Pages/EditAwardRedeem.php)): azione header "Correggi stato", visibile solo su richieste evase, con select (Pending/Cancellato) e nota obbligatoria. La sezione "Stato" in [AwardRedeemResource.php](app/Filament/Resources/AwardRedeemResource.php) mostra ora anche l'eventuale correzione con data e motivo.

**Test**: 5 nuovi test in [tests/Cases/AwardRedeemTest.php](tests/Cases/AwardRedeemTest.php) (correzione a pending, a cancellato con riaccredito, blocco se non evasa, nota obbligatoria, target non valido) — tutti passano, nessuna regressione sui test esistenti di AwardRedeem/User. <?php

namespace Spatie\EventSourcing\Console;

use Exception;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Spatie\EventSourcing\EventHandlers\Projectors\Projector;
use Spatie\EventSourcing\Projectionist;
use Spatie\EventSourcing\StoredEvents\Repositories\StoredEventRepository;

class ReplayCommand extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'event-sourcing:replay {projector?*}
                            {--from=0 : Replay events starting from this event number}
                            {--stored-event-model= : Replay events from this store}
                            {--aggregate-uuid= : Replay events for this aggregate only}
                            {--force : Replay events without asking for confirmation}';

    protected $description = 'Replay stored events';

    protected ?Projectionist $projectionist;

    public function handle(Projectionist $projectionist): void
    {
        $this->projectionist = $projectionist;

        $projectors = $this->selectProjectors($this->argument('projector'));

        if (is_null($projectors)) {
            $this->warn('No events replayed!');

            return;
        }

        if ($model = $this->option('stored-event-model')) {
            if (! class_exists($model)) {
                throw new Exception("Model {$model} not found. Make sure the model namespace is correct.");
            }

            config(['event-sourcing.stored_event_model' => $model]);
        }

        $this->replay($projectors, (int)$this->option('from'), $this->option('aggregate-uuid'));
    }

    public function selectProjectors(array $projectorClassNames): ?Collection
    {
        if (count($projectorClassNames) === 0) {
            if (! $this->option('force') && ! $this->confirm('Are you sure you want to replay events to all projectors?', true)) {
                return null;
            }

            return $this->projectionist->getProjectors();
        }

        return collect($projectorClassNames)
            ->map(fn (string $projectorName) => ltrim($projectorName, '\\'))
            ->map(function (string $projectorName) {
                if (! $projector = $this->projectionist->getProjector($projectorName)) {
                    throw new Exception("Projector {$projectorName} not found. Did you register it?");
                }

                return $projector;
            });
    }

    public function replay(Collection $projectors, int $startingFrom, ?string $aggregateUuid = null): void
    {
        $repository = app(StoredEventRepository::class);
        $events = collect($projectors->toArray())->map(fn (Projector $projector) => $projector->getEventHandlingMethods()->keys())->flatten()->toArray();
        $replayCount = $repository->countAllStartingFrom($startingFrom, $aggregateUuid, $events);

        if ($replayCount === 0) {
            $this->warn('There are no events to replay');

            return;
        }

        $this->comment("Replaying {$replayCount} events...");

        $bar = $this->output->createProgressBar($replayCount);
        $onEventReplayed = function () use ($bar) {
            $bar->advance();
        };

        $this->projectionist->replay($projectors, $startingFrom, $onEventReplayed, $aggregateUuid);

        $bar->finish();

        $this->emptyLine(2);
        $this->comment('All done!');
    }

    /** @psalm-suppress UnusedVariable */
    protected function emptyLine(int $amount = 1): void
    {
        foreach (range(1, $amount) as $i) {
            $this->line('');
        }
    }

    protected function isRunningInteractively(): bool
    {
        return false === $this->option('force');
    }
}

public function resetState(?string $aggregateUuid = null): void
{
    // reset your projector
}

 ```

If your projector contains an `onStartingEventReplay` method, we'll call it right before the first event is replayed.

If it contains an `onFinishedEventReplay` method, we'll call it right after all events have been replayed.
